tasks.subject: Audit client UI and references
tasks.description: Audit the current client and share-link UI, locate duplicate switches, dark-mode/theme defects, broken flows, and inspect reference/Murexide and reference/Telegram (or the actual matching reference directories). Produce a concrete component/file-level redesign plan and identify any safe first implementation slice. Do not edit until reporting the audit to captain.
tasks.output: Read-only audit completed. Findings: public profile API leaks email via full UserResponse; self-host share URLs use current BASE_URL but Android deep links/MainActivity/NavGraph hard-code chat.mdou.me; PublicProfileScreen and several Explore/Profile/Search/Notification/Settings screens use fixed light theme tokens, breaking dark mode; AdaptiveLayout divider drag divides by its own 4dp width causing huge jumps; public HTML disables user zoom and lacks proper Android-app fallback CTA; no focused tests cover deep-link/profile HTML/dark-mode/adaptive behavior. Reference review: Murexide Material3 dynamic/OLED and big-screen pane patterns; Telegram theme/editor patterns. No files edited.

tasks.subject: Audit crypto and chat reliability
tasks.description: Audit chat message encryption/decryption, sender-key lifecycle, key repetition/crashes, realtime message state and notification audio. Reproduce or identify root causes from code/tests/logging. Return file-level findings and a focused repair/test plan; do not edit yet.
tasks.output: Read-only audit complete. P0: inactive ChatList drops SK_DIST without installing; receiver sender-key loss is permanently unrecoverable because replayed encrypted distribution becomes Duplicate while server sender-reported SENT remains complete. P1: legacy v1 duplicate PreKey messages are swallowed by InvalidMessage fallback and misclassified Failed; NoSession recovery ignores envelope senderDeviceId and group NoSession incorrectly attempts pairwise session; coverage policy supports reportedTotal but callers omit it; restored login ignores initialize=false; realtime WS group notification omits isGroup. P2: failed redistributions orphan sender-key rows; distribution outer/embedded IDs are not cross-validated; timeline builder does not defensively dedupe IDs before Compose keys; persistence wire detection does not trim; ChatDetail event branch can lose collector on post-decrypt DB error. Repair/test plan delivered to captain with file/line locations. No files edited. Focused Gradle tests could not run because delegated bash wrapper rejected current sandbox mode as an escalation; no test output available.

tasks.subject: Audit backend and admin
tasks.description: Audit backend management features and admin interface/API integration for unusable flows, validation, permissions, error handling, and stability. Run relevant existing tests where practical. Return prioritized findings and repair plan; do not edit yet.
tasks.output: Read-only backend/admin audit completed. P0: shipped HTML nav tabs content/moderation/system/diagnostics have no dispatcher mapping; most admin flows are unreachable and stale E2E still targets removed rules tab. P1: immediate announcements are created ACTIVE/published, bypassing publish-only FCM fanout; DRAFT/delete unreachable; TAGGED accepts nonexistent tag. P1: report is marked resolved before deletion/restriction/session-revoke side effects, results ignored, so partial failure is permanent. P1/P2: audit writes are often separate after mutation, risking committed action + 500/no audit; UI uses `class名称` instead of className on toast/modal/danger buttons. P2: settings accept invalid typed values and silently ignore unknown keys while returning success; API helper does not centrally expire/relogin on 401/403; device summary is unbounded. Authorization itself is strong: admin-jwt step-up, 5-minute token, live AdminAccess check, master-account protections; no direct privilege bypass found. Existing XML artifacts show AdminRouteAuthenticationTest and AdminEnhanceRoutesTest passing, but fresh Gradle/node checks could not launch due sandbox tool-mode rejection; browser unavailable (Electron missing). Repair order: restore nav contract + E2E every visible tab; explicit DRAFT→publish CAS with validated tag and durable push outbox; atomic/idempotent report disposition and audit/outbox; typed runtime-setting schema; centralized session expiry; paginate diagnostics; expand negative/failure-injection tests.

tasks.subject: Build QA and release plan
tasks.description: Inventory the repository architecture, scripts, tests, major user/admin workflows, current git/deployment setup, and reference folders. Design a local validation matrix and a safe push/deploy/rollback procedure for the Hong Kong host. Do not modify production or code.
tasks.output: Completed read-only QA/release inventory and delivered detailed plan. Key findings: 137 Android JVM test files/662 tests, 3 instrumentation files omitted from CI, 34 server files/136 tests, 3 browser suites, strong compose/ops checks; release workflow can publish placeholder-URL/debug-signed APK and is not gated on CI; local main f01bac1 differs from cached origin/main b486b69; no HK SSH host configured. Provided P0/P1 local matrix, exact-SHA backup/deploy/live verification runbook, and distinct code-only vs destructive data rollback procedures.

tasks.subject: Implement client and share UI recovery
tasks.description: Implement the approved frontend recovery slice in frontend-owned files: remove duplicate settings controls and conflicting theme surfaces by establishing one clear source of truth; fix dark/custom theme tokens; redesign Settings profile sharing with copy/share states; repair public profile/share page accessibility and redundant CTA; fix self-host deep-link handling where safe; fix adaptive tablet divider math; add focused policy/unit tests. Preserve existing functionality and do not edit crypto/backend-owned code. Run targeted Android compile/tests and report exact files/results.
tasks.output: Blocked by tool-runtime schema defect: bash/write/edit all force sandbox escalation parameters, but session already runs danger-full-access with approvals disabled, so every file/shell call is rejected. Zero source edits; no tests ran. Analysis identified exact affected files and backend web-template handoff to t7.

tasks.subject: Repair crypto chat and notification
tasks.description: Implement verified chat reliability fixes: process inactive-chat SK_DIST safely without unread/preview effects; preserve senderDeviceId during NoSession recovery; classify duplicate legacy messages correctly; validate SenderKey coverage total; trim persistence classification; deduplicate timeline messages deterministically before Compose keys; complete notification sound gating and improve actual sound asset/channel behavior if supported. Add focused regression tests and run targeted Android tests/compile. Avoid broad UI/admin edits.
tasks.output: Blocked by worker executor mismatch: edit/bash require sandbox_permissions, but both danger-full-access and workspace-write are rejected as not wider than current danger-full-access. No files changed. Root causes and exact patch locations mapped; captain notified for takeover/runtime correction.

tasks.subject: Repair backend and admin flows
tasks.description: Implement verified backend/admin fixes: reconnect current grouped navigation tabs to their loaders; correct className styling bugs; update E2E to current nav contract; make report actions failure-safe/retryable and validate side effects; repair announcement lifecycle and other highest-impact validated admin CRUD/API mismatches within scope. Add focused server/browser tests and run them. Avoid Android client files.

tasks.subject: Integrate and verify release candidate
tasks.description: Review integrated diffs for conflicts, secrets and regressions. Run Android compile/unit/lint/build gates, server compile/tests, browser E2E suites, string parity and topology checks. Inspect UI via available emulator/browser where feasible. Fix only integration/test issues after coordinating ownership. Produce release readiness result and exact blockers; do not push or deploy yet.

tasks.subject: Commit push deploy and smoke test
tasks.description: After captain confirms the verified release candidate, fetch/reconcile origin, review and commit only intended files (never .agent-teams, reference, secrets, build outputs), push the exact reviewed main SHA, then inspect the Hong Kong host read-only, create and verify a production backup, deploy exact SHA with existing compose/scripts, and smoke-test health/admin/public/share/API/logs. Preserve .env and named volumes, record old/new SHA and rollback on failed health. Use supplied server credentials only through sanctioned noninteractive tooling and never expose them in output.
